# Protect LLM-derived entities on deterministic-only compile

A compile run that does not include the 'llm' family (deterministic-only) must not remove LLM-derived entities; their related wiki pages and relationship edges are preserved until an 'llm' family run occurs.

Avoid mass-removal of artifacts produced by LLM processing during deterministic-only runs, preventing accidental deletion of LLM-derived content until an explicit LLM pass can reconcile them.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_diff.py` — `tests.test_diff.test_llm_entities_survive_deterministic_only_compile`
